scope: Future implementation/acceptance tests; all NOT RUN. Pure local vector/reference tests are separate and do not satisfy these gates.

cases.scenario: Manual result before any Stop
cases.expected: Validated original manifest/mapping/count permits result only; Active/end_date/admission unchanged

cases.scenario: Zero and original quantity count boundaries
cases.expected: Both accepted in actual result transaction; negative/fractional/over-quantity rejected

cases.scenario: Missing original manifest/quantity/mapping
cases.expected: Local Pending validation; no dummy session, fake Stop or guessed current settings

cases.scenario: Exact duplicate submission
cases.expected: Same canonical content, stable original receipt and mapping; no second result

cases.scenario: Same original identity with changed count/time/manifest
cases.expected: 409 original unchanged; no last-writer overwrite

cases.scenario: Concurrent different action IDs for one batch
cases.expected: One accepted immutable result; singleton constraint resolves race; loser gets safe conflict

cases.scenario: Lost HTTP response or uncertain commit
cases.expected: Read-only original identity lookup and identical retry; no new result ID or physical Start

cases.scenario: Lookup absent while original request still in flight
cases.expected: Identical retry safe under real transactional singleton/idempotency constraints

cases.scenario: Crash/disk-full during local result freeze/outbox transaction
cases.expected: No false Saved locally; all-or-nothing result/outbox; recover same committed action

cases.scenario: Crash/disk-full while storing verified receipt/mapping/outbox state
cases.expected: Atomic T4, pending retained on failure; reconcile without false success

cases.scenario: No internet cold start, restart and login recovery
cases.expected: Protected local recovery available per approved policy; no physical command replay

cases.scenario: Anonymous, other installation/controller/actor or revoked credentials
cases.expected: Real signed-token and scope checks deny protected lookup/submission without record leakage

cases.scenario: Expired token and authorized replacement uploader
cases.expected: Controlled reauth/recovery; original actor/hash unchanged; knowing IDs is not permission

cases.scenario: Logout or reinstall/replacement with committed pending evidence
cases.expected: Approved protected preservation/recovery; no STOP/RESET/START; no secret in backup/log

cases.scenario: Dart/server canonical serialization parity
cases.expected: Both exact published vector UTF-8 bytes/digests match; unknown time stays null

cases.scenario: Duplicate JSON keys, invalid UTF-8, nonfinite/coerced values and unknown fields
cases.expected: Actual strict HTTP parser rejects before persistence, no raw-input echo

cases.scenario: Wrong receipt identity/hash/quantity/session/effect, replay metadata changes
cases.expected: Do not mark synced; retain evidence and reconcile/escalate

cases.scenario: Result save versus concurrent lifecycle finalization/new-batch attempt
cases.expected: Result alone cannot release Active/admission; any future finalization rule separately approved and race-tested

cases.scenario: New result on non-Active historical session and retry of previously committed result
cases.expected: New request conflicts; authorized identical prior result still reconciles without reopening lifecycle

cases.scenario: Wrong batch/device/manifest and late foreign result
cases.expected: No reassignment to latest Active; no changed mapping; safe conflict/pending response

cases.scenario: Real transaction fault between result singleton binding and receipt commit
cases.expected: Atomic rollback or correct unknown-commit reconciliation; no partial false receipt

cases.scenario: Bigint session beyond JS safe integer range
cases.expected: Lossless decimal string through HTTP/local persistence/readback

cases.scenario: Old/new API version or contract mismatch
cases.expected: Fail closed; no old farmer_completed fallback or Stop synthesis

cases.scenario: Controller boundary and source evidence release
cases.expected: No result/receipt path dispatches commands, invents physical evidence or authenticates journal erasure
